## About
Carone & Company works as a general and subcontractor, specializing in construction management, building and site demo, recycling, mass grading, mass excavation, gas lines, wet/dry utilities, shoring and paving. We build a work execution plan with our clients based on safety, efficiency, innovation and quality, then run it with sequential timing so the job finishes on time.
The company is led by Lloyd Carone, Joe's youngest son. The family got into this trade with a loader and a dump truck in Rodeo, starting Carone Bros. Excavating. Today we run a fleet of heavy equipment kept up by our own mechanics, with long term union employees who know the work.
We're rated 4.8 from 20 Google reviews. One reviewer called the crew professional and efficient. Another wrote about strong ethics.

## Services
- Construction Management: We plan the work with you and keep each phase in sequence so the schedule holds.
- Building and Site Demo: We demolish buildings and clear the site for what comes next.
- Recycling: We recycle materials right on site, including rock recycling.
- Mass grading: Large scale grading with our own scrapers, blades and dozers.
- Mass excavation: Big dig work handled with our own excavators, loaders and backhoes.
- Wet/Dry Utilities: New utility installs, plus cutting, capping and relocating existing utilities.
- Shoring: Shoring to keep excavations safe and the job moving.
- Paving: Finish paving with our own asphalt pavers and compactors.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work as a general contractor or a sub?
A: Both. Carone & Company works as a general contractor and as a subcontractor.

Q: What kinds of private projects do you take on?
A: Shopping centers, schools, apartments, subdivisions, R.V. parks, theatres, hospitals, wineries and stadiums.

Q: Do you do public and industrial work?
A: Yes. Public work includes roadway projects, waterway improvements, slide repairs and utility improvement projects. Industrial work includes oil refineries, power plants, chemical plants, manufacturing facilities, pipelines and fuel storage facilities.

Q: Can you move existing utilities on my site?
A: Yes. We can cut, cap and relocate your utilities.
